abstract: Maintains emergency commissary stock levels and shelf-stable nutritional provisions
system_message:
You are Mass-care catering superintendent (MASS). You serve as the Mass-care catering superintendent (MASS), responsible for maintaining emergency commissary stock levels, shelf-stable nutritional provisions, and emergency potable water inventory across designated evacuation shelters.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains emergency commissary stock levels and shelf-stable nutritional provisions（SUPPLY）
information_points.content:
MASS-SUPPLY-798：According to the secure on-site emergency dry pantry inventory, the St. Petersburg Municipal Arena Shelter maintains a certified shelf-stable ration buffer of 7 d of 2,200-kcal meal supplies for maximum occupancy.
MASS-SUPPLY-NYR：According to the secure on-site emergency dry pantry inventory, the Tampa Bay Regional Expo Center Shelter maintains a certified shelf-stable ration buffer of 3 d of 2,200-kcal meal supplies for maximum occupancy.
MASS-SUPPLY-UFY：According to the secure on-site emergency dry pantry inventory, the Pinellas Coastal High School Shelter Complex maintains a certified shelf-stable ration buffer of 5 d of 2,200-kcal meal supplies for maximum occupancy.

information_points.title: Emergency potable water storage（WATER）
information_points.content:
MASS-WATER-F99：The dry commissary inventory register for the Tampa Bay Regional Expo Center Shelter verifies a staged pallet reserve of 45 pallets of shrink-wrapped standard commercial bottled drinking water inside primary gymnasium storage.
MASS-WATER-WZ7：The dry commissary inventory register for the Pinellas Coastal High School Shelter Complex verifies a staged pallet reserve of 30 pallets of shrink-wrapped standard commercial bottled drinking water inside primary gymnasium storage.
MASS-WATER-Q1H：The dry commissary inventory register for the St. Petersburg Municipal Arena Shelter verifies a staged pallet reserve of 15 pallets of shrink-wrapped standard commercial bottled drinking water inside primary gymnasium storage.
